PROFESSIONAL PROFILE

General surgeon with a clinical focus on bariatric surgery. He trained at Example University and now works in Istanbul. He has participated in more than 1,000 bariatric procedures, as stated in his professional biography.

PROFESSIONAL BIOGRAPHY

Örnek Doktor was born in Erzincan in 1989 and completed his education there. He studied medicine at Example University.
From 2020 to 2023, he worked as a General Surgery Specialist. His professional biography reports experience in more than 1,000 bariatric procedures.
